episodes.synopsis: It is Tooru Kokonoe's first day and he attends the entrance ceremony for Kouryou Academy where all the students have to demonstrate their capabilities with their Blaze weapons.
episodes.title: Blaze

episodes.synopsis: Tor and Julie settle in as roommates until the time comes to form official Duos. Each has an ideal partner in mind, but will they get what they want?
episodes.title: Duo

episodes.synopsis: Tor and Julie face an unexpected hurdle at the end of their mock-battle tournament. Julie confronts Tor about someone from his past.
episodes.title: Avenger

episodes.synopsis: Transfer student Lilith Bristol joins Tor's class and immediately flaunts her status as an Exception. Tor and Julie go into town for some shopping.
episodes.title: Exception

episodes.synopsis: The Rite of Sublimation has given Tor and his friends upgraded powers. Lilith has another proposal for Tor ahead of a challenging inter-class battle.
episodes.title: Level Up

episodes.synopsis: Lilith ropes her fellow students into fighting her in a battle royale. A mysterious figure shows up out of nowhere with his own plans for Lilith.
episodes.title: Survive

episodes.synopsis: The class is off to a seaside summer camp, but this is Koryo Academy. No ordinary school function is complete without some kind of combat.
episodes.title: Silver-Blonde, Yellow Topaz

episodes.synopsis: A week of training is capped off by a day at leisure--and where better to unwind than at the beach? Miyabi takes a big step in her feelings about Tor.
episodes.title: Selection

episodes.synopsis: Koryo Academy is under attack! Tor and Julie work together in battling the chief of the marauding corps, while Tomoe searches for a missing Miyabi.
episodes.title: Rebels

episodes.synopsis: Miyabi is still MIA as Koryo Academy prepares to host the mysterious Reign group. Tor presses Lilith for answers about Absolute Duo.
episodes.title: Reign Conference

episodes.synopsis: Tor and his friends confront the Rebels in Smith's grand killing game. Tomoe realizes she knows little about her Duo. K challenges Tor to a rematch.
episodes.title: Killing Game

episodes.synopsis: The idea of wanting to protect someone is still foreign to K, so in a dramatic, no-holds-barred faceoff, Tor decides to show him how it's done.
episodes.title: Absolute Duo
